meta.angle: Magnesio Glicinato - "Hai comprato il magnesio. Ti aspettavi miracoli?"
meta.pain-targeted: Pillole/integratori shopping list senza vero risultato - magic-pill thinking

image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena Higgsfield reference), lived-in face, warm brown shoulder-length hair loose. Standing in a clean modern Italian kitchen at morning light. She wears soft cream short-sleeve linen shirt.
She holds a generic supplement bottle (white plastic bottle with no readable label, no brand) up at chest level with her left hand, looking at it with a knowing skeptical expression. Her right hand rests casually on her hip.
Camera: iPhone 15 Pro vertical shot, eye level, subject distance 100cm.
Light: single soft window light from camera-left at 45°, color temperature 5300K (clean morning), subtle natural fill.
Expression: Italian "lo sguardo del 'aspetta che ti spiego'" - both eyebrows neutral, mouth slight smirk right corner mouth raised 3mm, eyes direct camera with informed skepticism. Subtle chin tilt down 1° for educational tone.
Aesthetic reference: Modern Italian wellness Instagram 2026, Carlotta Perego naturalism, Federica Fontana directness. NOT cinematic.
Body: real Italian woman 45, average, real arms.
Color grading: neutral + 3% warmth, slight saturation on pink elements only.
Composition: subject center frame, supplement bottle visible mid-frame held up, plenty of clean negative space top/bottom for brand overlay.
image-generation.negative-prompt: cinematic editorial, golden hour, Sofia Coppola, real supplement brand visible, Solgar Now Foods readable label, model thin, beauty retouch, makeup heavy, instagram filter, dramatic
